Shortcuts press ? or H to close

1–6Plan, Looking up, Top, Long A-A, Cross B-B, 3DFFit the view
VSelect: click anything, drag its handlesShift+clickAdd a second wall (then Join corner)
WWall: click along the face, Enter or double click finishesCPillar: one click, fitted from the scan
NOpening: click both sides of the gapRRoof: click round it, Enter closes
Type digitsExact length of the next leg while drawing, Enter places itAlt / ShiftStraight, no snap / keep to the axis
Z M L TZone, Measure, Section, NoteXClean up: select stray splats, Delete removes them
SSnap on or offF11Full screen
Ctrl+C / VCopy the picked object or skylight, paste it where the pointer isClick a measurementPick it: drag its ends, Delete removes it
Q / E3D: swing the view 45° round the point you are placingShift+Q/E3D: tilt 15° up or down
EscCancel what you are drawing, then leave the toolDelDelete the selected object
Ctrl+Z / YUndo / redoCtrl+DCopy the selected pillar or opening
Double clickNew corner on a wall or roof edge; a pillar becomes a free outlineRight clickDelete the corner or object under it
3DDrag empty space turns, right drag pans, wheel zooms toward the pointer, double click turns round that spotCtrl+SSave the job
KCurved wall: click both ends, move away to bend, click. Select it and drag the white circle to re-bendF9Copy the view with the pointer marked, to paste into the chat
F10Record 5 seconds of the view: a picture strip to paste into the chat, and a video in Downloads
DoorPick Single, Double, Sliding, Glazed or Fire on the bar, then click both sides. Flip hinge or swing in the right panelTidy upRight panel or right click: squares, levels, lines up openings. Ctrl+Z undoes it
